key_tasks: Deep plough and prepare fine tilth
Apply basal FYM and level field
stages.fertilizer: Basal dose incorporated into soil (FYM + NPK)
stages.irrigation: Pre-sowing irrigation to ensure adequate moisture

key_tasks: Sow seeds at appropriate depth and spacing
Check for uniform emergence and gap-fill if necessary
stages.fertilizer: No additional fertilizer; rely on basal dose
stages.irrigation: Light irrigation if soil surface dries out to prevent crusting

key_tasks: Scout for foliar pests and diseases weekly
stages.irrigation: Regular irrigation cycle based on crop water requirements
stages.pest_disease_monitoring: Leaf-eating caterpillars, aphids, early signs of leaf blight

key_tasks: Avoid chemical sprays during peak flowering to protect pollinators
stages.fertilizer: Avoid heavy Nitrogen; focus on Potassium if deficient
stages.irrigation: Critical stage: ensure no moisture stress to prevent flower/fruit drop
stages.pest_disease_monitoring: Flower drop, pod borers, sucking pests

key_tasks: Ensure proper drainage if heavy rains occur
Final rounds of irrigation before maturity
stages.fertilizer: Foliar application if nutrient deficiency is visible

key_tasks: Dry produce to safe moisture levels before storage
stages.irrigation: Stop irrigation to allow drying and maturation
